answer: **Natural-language hypothesis (финальный ответ):** Индивиды с криминальным прошлым (прокси: ever_jailed = заключение в 1985–1994) имели статистически значимо более низкое благосостояние (wealth), чем без него, **во все три наблюдаемых года — 1985, 1990 и 1996**. Медиана wealth в группе jailed vs non-jailed: 1985 — $720 против $3,600; 1990 — $0 против $10,500; 1996 — $0 против $8,500. Односторонний Mann–Whitney U (гипотеза «jailed ниже»): p = 8.0×10⁻¹¹ (1985), 3.9×10⁻³⁵ (1990), 4.6×10⁻²⁶ (1996), что ниже и порога α=0.05, и Бонферрони (α/3≈0.0167; скорр. p = 2.4×10⁻¹⁰ / 1.2×10⁻³⁴ / 1.4×10⁻²⁵). Знак эффекта (jailed ниже) согласован во всех проверках устойчивости. **Оговорка:** wealth-1985 у части лиц измерен до заключения (ever_jailed покрывает 1985–1994), поэтому результат — устойчивая ассоциация, а не установленная причинность.

payload.hypothesis: Individuals with a criminal record (ever_jailed, jailed 1985-1994) had significantly lower wealth than those without in ALL three observed years: 1985, 1990, and 1996. Median wealth jailed vs non-jailed: $720 vs $3,600 (1985), $0 vs $10,500 (1990), $0 vs $8,500 (1996). One-sided Mann-Whitney U p = 8.0e-11 / 3.9e-35 / 4.6e-26, all below both alpha=0.05 and Bonferroni threshold 0.0167 (corrected p = 2.4e-10 / 1.2e-34 / 1.4e-25); effect sizes (Z/sqrt(N)) = -0.058 / -0.112 / -0.093 (negative = jailed lower). Sign consistent across median (quantile) regression and OLS on winsorized and log-shifted wealth with race/sex controls (negative significant ever_jailed coefficient in all years). Caveat: wealth-1985 may be measured before incarceration for some respondents, so this is a robust association, not established causation.
payload.workflow: 1) Inspected data (12,013 rows, no missing values; ever_jailed 289 vs 11,724). 2) Primary: one-sided Mann-Whitney U per year (1985/1990/1996), H1 = jailed wealth lower; reported medians/means, U, z, raw p, Bonferroni-corrected p (3 tests, threshold 0.0167), effect sizes r=Z/sqrt(N). 3) Robustness: median (quantile) regression wealth ~ ever_jailed + race + sex; OLS on winsorized wealth (clip 99th pct) with same controls; OLS on log(wealth - min + 1) with same controls. 4) Conclusion: years where one-sided p < 0.05 (and < 0.0167) AND sign consistent across all checks -> all three years 1985, 1990, 1996.
